## Objective
This is to compute a set of features to summarize lymphocyte distribution features in
feline small intestinal biopsies.

The analysis will be done per tissue fragment (after automatic filtering of inaadequate orientation
and artefact)

## Input
- <image>_<fragment>_<mucosa>_lymphocyte_centroids.geojson (fe_si_models/combos/output/mapped_ai_output/ )
Contains lymphocyte centroids coordinates (mapped by compartment and layer)
- <image>_<fragment>_<mucosa>_mapped_ai_output.geojson (fe_si_models/combos/output/mapped_ai_output/ )
Contains layers, tissue compartments and lymphocyte outline coordinates (grouped by class)
